listed_sector_signals.signal: Cited reference on energy performance indicators in kraft pulp mills (pulp & paper continuous production), appears only in the bibliography, not in the paper's own application
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Decarbonization of Industry: Implementation of Energy Performance
Indicators for Successful Energy Management Practices in Kraft Pulp Mills. Energy Rep. 2021, 7, 1808–1817.

one_line: The paper develops and validates energy baseline (EnBL) estimation methodologies—time series, regression, and dynamic simulation—for a university classroom building on the UAO campus, a commercial/institutional building context, not continuous-flow industrial production.
